name: hidden_visibility_excludes_from_tool_list
description: ref:conformance.hidden_op is registered with ToolVisibility::Hidden. The server must exclude it from Request::ToolList responses. Third-party servers that want to validate this case must expose a tool with id `ref:conformance.hidden_op` declaring `visibility: "hidden"` and arrange for it to be registered (atd does this when `--enable-conformance-tool` is passed). describe-by-id and call-by-id are exercised by the sibling fixtures `hidden_tool_describable_by_id` and `hidden_tool_callable_by_id`.
